text:
Maya (People Ops): quick note  we're rolling a small handbook update clarifying documentation & timelines for parental leave pay top-ups and a short manager microtraining next Wed. please review draft + RSVP: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/parental-topup-draft :memo:

Ravi (Manager): will this change eligibility or just the admin steps?

Maya (People Ops): admin only. clarifies evidence types, timelines for payroll submission, and a simple manager sign-off flow. no change to eligibility thresholds.

Omar (Payroll): we need a stable CSV schema to auto-ingest top-up requests. recommend header exactly as below to avoid parsing errors:

```
emp_id, emp_email, leave_type, leave_start, leave_end, topup_requested (Y/N), topup_amount, docs_attached (Y/N), manager_approval_ts, payroll_action
```

Jin (Legal): note: certain jurisdictions require confidentiality for medical docs. handbook should instruct managers to mark docs as 'confidential' in HRIS and not upload to shared drives.

Priya (People Ops): adding two 30m drop-ins for managers: Wed 10:30 PT and Thu 15:00 PT. RSVP sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/s/parental-topup-rsvp. please add headcount and whether you approve top-ups.

Ravi (Manager): ordering: if manager approves a top-up retroactively, what's the cut-off for payroll to avoid mid-cycle manual work?

Omar (Payroll): retro approvals accepted up to 7 calendar days after return-to-work. after that we treat as special payroll adjustment and require HR ticket. we'll document this.

Maya (People Ops): action items: 1) managers add headcounts by EOD Tue; 2) Priya to publish 1-slide FAQ + 90s clip after sessions; 3) Jin to add confidentiality note; 4) Omar to confirm CSV ingest schedule.

people-ops-bot: automated reminder set  RSVP sheet closes 48h before first session.

Priya (People Ops): small ask  can L&D make a 60s script I can paste into manager updates? saves us repeating the same guidance.

Jin (Legal): will send a short blurb on jurisdictional caveats for the FAQ slide.

Ravi (Manager): signed up for Wed session (team of 5, 1 acting manager).

Maya (People Ops): thanks all  we'll publish the final handbook patch after sessions and post a changelog entry. link to draft again: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/parental-topup-draft :link:
